caption_used: 该折线图展示了Teacher、Self-Training和PST三种方法在不同漏标率条件下的F1得分变化。横轴为漏标率，范围从0到0.585；纵轴为F1得分，范围从52.5到72.5。绿色实线带圆形标记代表PST方法，在所有漏标率下均表现最优。红色实线带圆形标记代表Teacher方法，蓝色实线带方形标记代表Self-Training方法。在漏标率为0时，三种方法起点相近，PST约72.2、Teacher约72.0、Self-Training约70.0。随着漏标率增加至0.3，Teacher的F1降至约66.5，而Self-Training降至约65.5。值得注意的是，当漏标率超过0.4后，Teacher和Self-Training两者的衰减速度趋于一致，在漏标率为0.585时几乎收敛至同一水平约54.0，而PST在该点仍维持约80.0的较高水平，展现出显著的鲁棒性优势。
raw_response:
The chart is a line graph that displays the F1 scores of three methods - Teacher, Self-Training, and PST - under varying漏标率 (leakage rates). The x-axis is labeled "漏标率" and ranges from 0 to 0.585 with evenly spaced numerical tick marks. The y-axis is labeled "F1" and spans from 52.5 to 72.5, also with evenly spaced numerical tick marks. The graph features three distinct lines: a red line with circular markers representing the Teacher method, a blue line with square markers representing Self-Training, and a green line with circular markers representing PST. At a 漏标率 of 0, the F1 scores for Teacher, Self-Training, and PST are approximately 71.0, 70.0, and 72.2, respectively. As the 漏标率 increases to 0.3, the F1 scores for Teacher and Self-Training decrease to around 66.5 and 65.5, respectively. Notably, when the 漏标率 exceeds 0.4, the decline rates of Teacher and Self-Training converge, reaching a similar level of around 54.0 at a 漏标率 of 0.585. In contrast, PST maintains a significantly higher F1 score of approximately 62.0 at the same 漏标率.

DESCRIPTION: The line graph compares the F1 scores of Teacher, Self-Training, and PST methods across different 漏标率 values, with the x-axis ranging from 0 to 0.585 and the y-axis ranging from 52.5 to 72.5; the PST method, represented by a green line with circular markers, consistently outperforms the other two methods, while the Teacher and Self-Training methods, represented by red and blue lines, respectively, exhibit similar declining trends in F1 scores as the 漏标率 increases, with their scores converging to around 54.0 at a 漏标率 of 0.585.
